title: Loom weave config, v1
$comment: Per-platform knobs the generator needs beyond the manifest itself: where the native HTTP surface lives, how callers authenticate (ADR-060 §3.3 by class), and what the npm packet is called. Lives in each platform repo next to its manifest (contracts/weave.json).

allOf.$comment: Woven servers (Class D/C) need the HTTP base, auth, and package name. Native servers (Class A) implement their own server and need none of these.

server.$comment: Default 'woven': the Loom emits the MCP packet (Class D/C). 'native': the platform implements its MCP server itself over an in-process registry (Class A / agent-host — a woven proxy would HTTP-hop to itself). For 'native' the Loom validates the manifest and emits only the conformance driver; no JS packet, no Python twin.

base_env.$comment: env var that overrides base_default, e.g. WINDY_TALK_CONTROL_URL

token_env.$comment: env var carrying the raw token (overrides the file)

token_path_env.$comment: env var overriding the token file path

python_module.$comment: Name for the generated Python twin module; defaults to product with dashes → underscores.
